routes.GET /operator/status: Sanitized status only; never starts or claims work
routes.POST /operator/preflight: Empty object; disabled mode only; fixed --check-only command; returns status
routes.POST /operator/activate: Exact sourceSha,imageRef,versionId object; fresh matching preflight required; returns status
routes.POST /operator/deactivate: Empty object; stops future cycles, lets current cycle drain; returns status
routes.POST /operator/tick: Empty object; only an approved active release may start one queue cycle

preflightPass.checkedAt: ISO 8601 UTC; maximum activation age 15 minutes
